title: Service principal holds a high-impact Microsoft Graph permission
detail: A service principal has been granted a Microsoft Graph application permission from the high-impact set (directory, role-management, application, consent, authentication-method and site-control write permissions). These permissions let an app read or rewrite the tenant's directory, roles, apps or consent, so they are tenant-takeover-grade and should be rare and deliberate. The permission name is resolved from Microsoft Graph's own appRoles; an unresolved grant is reported not assessed, never passed. This rule matches only grants on the Microsoft Graph resource app.
